objective: Add a deterministic controller boundary that accepts externally authored engineering proposals, applies only validated mutations, and owns verification without invoking a second model.
acceptance: The repository controller never invokes an AI model or requires model-provider credentials.
A proposal is accepted only after the current manifest has been independently re-verified.
Every proposal is bound to the manifest run_id and exact Git commit before mutation.
Only full-file replacements inside allowed_scope can be applied; forbidden, ignored, symlinked, oversized, or unexpected mutations are rejected.
Required verification gates are controller-owned and cannot be removed or altered by proposal content.
Failed candidate verification is rolled back immediately; revised proposals are separate external engineering iterations rather than controller-owned model retries.
NEEDS_MORE_CONTEXT, ARCHITECTURE_CONTRADICTION, UNKNOWN_ENVIRONMENT, and BLOCKED stop without repository mutation.
Missing or malformed proposals, stale manifests, dirty worktrees, unknown verification gates, and verifier-created mutations stop safely.
A deterministic external-proposal fixture exercises the same mutation and verification controller on a tiny Android bootstrap change without any model or network call.
Checkpoint 3 remains isolated on a candidate branch and draft pull request until its exact-head CI evidence is reviewed.
